rows.title: Upgrade `content-type` to ^2.0.0
rows.model_rationale: Dependency bump that changes documented behavior of `res.send()`: existing Content-Type parameters are now preserved and invalid Content-Type headers no longer throw. The PR itself added a History.md changelog entry, confirming user-facing relevance.
rows.label_rationale: Framed as a dependency bump, but it changes res.send()'s observable behavior: existing Content-Type parameters are now preserved when the charset is added, and a malformed Content-Type no longer throws. History.md documents the new behavior with an example in the same PR.
